name: Tavern Brawler
description:
Accustomed to the rough-and-tumble fighting using whatever weapons happen to be at hand, you gain the following benefits:
- You are proficient with improvised weapons, and they use a d6 for damage.
- When you hit a creature with an improvised weapon, you may take a Stress to deal an additional d6 of damage. The weapon then breaks.
- When you hit a creature with an improvised weapon, your next Shove or Grapple attack against the target has advantage until the end of your next turn.
